description: The Snapshot Summary and the per-file snapshot lines (B23a), under Jest 30.5.2 with `--ci=false` so snapshots are written: `written.test.ts` writes one, `failed.test.ts` fails a stored one, `obsolete.test.ts` has an unused stored key. Jest prints ` › N snapshot ...` under each file and the summary block before the totals. The recorder runs outside npm, so the update command reads ``re-run jest with `-u` ``. One worker. A black-box run.
